card.name: Small linking words before study details
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as "in", "a" and "with" right after a noun phrase, where a population, year, or study description comes next. Also the "S" that starts SGLT2 after "an".

modes.label: Preposition after a condition or title

modes.label: Start of SGLT2 after an
modes.description: The letter "S" begins the drug class name SGLT2 in a lithium interaction statement.
